title: 60 days in: is your plan working? (Short)

lines.say: Two months into the year. Is your money plan working?
Ask four questions. Is the debt going down? Did the surprise fund work? Is the plan still true? And what's the next big move?

lines.cap: In our example, the card went from $3,200 to $2,576.
lines.say: In our example, the card went from thirty-two hundred to twenty-five seventy-six.
And a tax refund on the card makes it debt-free in month five, instead of ten.
